faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Who can use the herbal reference checker?
faq.a1: This tool is restricted to adults aged 18 to 120. HerbAlly does not calculate, extrapolate, or recommend herbal doses for children, infants, or unverified ages. Consult a qualified pediatric healthcare professional instead.
faq.q2: Why were Clark's, Young's, Fried's, and BSA scaling removed?
faq.a2: Classic pediatric and weight-scaling formulas were designed for single-agent pharmaceuticals, not multi-compound botanical extracts. HerbAlly removed all weight/age scaling rules and only confirms the unscaled adult reference amount entered or sourced from reviewed adult monographs.
faq.q3: Is the adult reference checker free?
faq.a3: Yes — free, no account required. Adult reference ranges appear only when monograph data cites authoritative sources (EMA HMPC, Health Canada, WHO, NCCIH, or PubMed); toxic or non-dosable plants are blocked.

Herbal products vary widely in concentration and lack validated pediatric dosing. Please consult a qualified pediatric healthcare professional before giving any herbal product to a minor.
calculatorForm.ageRequiredForAdultDose: Enter a confirmed adult age between {age} and 120 years. HerbAlly cannot verify whether a user with an empty or implausible age is an adult and therefore refuses to confirm any dose.
calculatorForm.pediatricDoseBlockedRationale: Software scope notice: historical scaling formulas (Clark's, Young's, Fried's, BSA) are disabled across HerbAlly because they are not validated for botanical products.
calculatorForm.adultReferenceDesc: Confirms the unscaled adult reference amount without weight- or age-scaling math. Always confirm individual suitability with a licensed pharmacist or clinician.
calculatorForm.dangerousHerbBlockedFooter: HerbAlly never computes or displays home doses for plants with severe or lethal toxicity hazards. If exposure occurred, contact Poison Control or emergency medical care.
calculatorForm.nonDosableHerbBlockedTitle: Herb not eligible for oral dose calculation
calculatorForm.nonDosableHerbBlockedDesc: This plant is restricted to external/topical use, lacks an established quantitative adult oral dose, or carries safety limits that prohibit automated dosing. Consult a licensed pharmacist or clinician.
calculatorForm.adultOnlyNotice: Adults 18+ only: HerbAlly does not calculate herbal doses for children, adolescents, infants, or unknown ages, and does not apply weight-scaling formulas.

herbDrugInteractionsPage.heading: Herb–Drug Interactions
herbDrugInteractionsPage.intro: Herbs and supplements can change how your medications work — sometimes dangerously. This guide explains what herb–drug interactions are, which combinations are riskiest, and how to check before you combine.

herbDrugInteractionsPage.checkerCtaBody: Use the interaction checker on the homepage — it checks the HerbAlly database first and shows a structured result when a pair is recorded.

npnCheckerPage.heading: Health Canada NPN Supplement Decoder
npnCheckerPage.intro: Enter the 8-digit Natural Product Number (NPN) or DIN-HM printed on a supplement bottle sold in Canada to fetch Health Canada's official LNHPD licence, medicinal ingredients, cautions, and drug interaction matches.
npnCheckerPage.explainerBody1: Natural health products sold legally in Canada carry an 8-digit NPN (or DIN-HM for homeopathic remedies). HerbAlly queries Health Canada's official public Licensed Natural Health Products Database (LNHPD) live without storing personal medication searches.
npnCheckerPage.explainerBody2: Whenever a licensed medicinal ingredient is a botanical tracked in HerbAlly, you can jump straight to its full clinical monograph or screen every botanical ingredient in the bottle against your prescriptions.
